div.head: Abt 53
div.ab: Se þe earm þurhstinð, VI scillingum gebete.
Se þe earm þurhstinð, VI scillingum gebete.
Se þe earm þurh stinð, VI scillingum gebete.
Wer einen Arm durchsticht, büsse mit 6 Schillingen.
Whoever stabs through an arm, let him pay 6 shillings.
He who pierces an arm shall pay 6 shillings compensation.
He who stabs through an arm, let him pay with 6 shillings.

note.seg: Durchstechen und Brechen des Armes büssen ebenso mit 6 Schilling Pact. Alam. II 5. 13 und Lex Baiuwar. I 4, 12. Vgl. Gl Arm 1. 2; Gliederbussen 6
Piercing and breaking the arm are likewise compensated with 6 shillings in Pact. Alam. II 5. 13 and Lex Baiuwar. I 4, 12. Cf. Gl Arm 1. 2; Gliederbussen 6
